function ensureRegistryBody(s, rec): void;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/registry-body.ts:300

Materializes the rendered body for a catalog record at its true heliocentric chart position — the object the cloud point stands in for. LRU-cached on s.registryBodies; a cache overflow evicts and disposes the oldest spawn so mesh count stays bounded. No-ops on missing THREE/deps (pre-boot), missing Sun pivot, or dispose.
